title: Bullets of Fury - Shump that proves AI does what they don't.
author: MikesWorldNYC
selftext:
Bullets of Fury is my take at a Shump that takes what inspired it and goes above and beyond. Inspired by titles like Fireshark, Raiden, 1942, R-Type and more, you are in for treat. 

  
Currently there are 6 weapon types

Ice Orb

Laser

Machine Guns

Firewalls

Homing Missiles

Spreadfire

  
6 characters + 1 secret character

Yuri - Chain Lightning Strike

Maverick - Double Helix Laser attack

Axel -  Power Shield

Freezer - Time Distortion

Juggernaut - Wrecking Ball

Decker - Cloaking System

  
Secret Character

Cole - Nuke Missiles

  
There are 5 Stages plus 1 final stage if you meet certain conditions within the game.

  
A rival dog mode that is very in alpha, it is not nearly as finished and does not work as intended at this time.

  
Enemy and Boss behaivor is basic but will receive weapon attachments and unique attack patterns. 

  
Are you ready, for bullets of fury? 

  
Coming soon to a html browser near you!
